scope: Standalone level-plus-indicator entry filters, research only. Reuse accepted signals, POC map, candles, feature math and execution/audit engines; no new entry geometry or exit search.
entry: Consume original LV02 groups without target/stop/evidence fields in execution actions. Preserve original IDs, clocks, side, daily signal cap and all raw opportunities, not accepted trades only. PD means previous completed UTC calendar day: rejection short at its high, breakout/retest long at its high. NPOC long uses original downward daily naked touch; NPOC short uses original 15m rejection from below. These are four distinct parents; never pool their dollars as one portfolio.
features: Reuse PI01 indicatorTape and its fixed seed on the saved continuous candle atlas. Snapshot at original signal.at with lag 60s primary and 120s sensitivity. Use crsi_15, roc5_60 and cmf_60 only. Common readiness requires all three finite/non-null; ready is a diagnostic parent. CRSI long<=10 / short>=90; ROC5 1h long<=-2% / short>=+2%; CMF20 1h long>=+0.05 / short<=-0.05. These are states at the level event, not the older standalone crossing entries. No later feature refresh at delayed fill, no next-candle return, no new indicator formulas.
npocRoom: At signal.at-featureLag query the accepted Bybit width0.1 map as of that time. Only published eligible daily profiles with status untested qualify. Exclude the originating NPOC profile ID for NPOC parents. Long obstacle: row.upper>=observedPrice; short obstacle: row.lower<=observedPrice; overlap counts zero distance. Reuse nearest() on that directional pool. Observed price is last known one-minute close ending signal.at-60000, invariant across feature lag. A known obstacle within inclusive2% denies; absent obstacles mean no known veto, not certified safety. Save published/uncertain/naked counts and exact selected row. npoc_room also requires common indicator readiness; cmf_npoc_room requires both cmf_aligned and npoc_room. Retain room-only and CMF-only controls to isolate each component. Do not use final naked status, recalculate profiles, or block on the originating bounce level itself.
ownership: All filters freeze at signal time. Recompute full one-position occupancy for each side/entry/exit/condition; no virtual queue, same-minute retrospective refill, averaging or compounding. Retain common/removed/displaced/new trades and cutoff-open attribution using existing helper. Compare combos to baseline, readiness, CMF alone and room alone. Both TP/SL and timed12 controls have identical entry series. Stops/targets anchor to actual fill, existing stop-first primary and target-first sensitivity unchanged.
screen: Inherited full/older/recent x0/60s: positive net and +5bps per side stressed net; >=30 full and10 each subperiod closes; no exhausted equity; all monthly MTM>=-250 versus cash. Relative: positive delta, nonworse adverse DD, monthly delta>=-250 versus identical unfiltered and readiness parents. Primary at60s source lag; survival additionally at120s. Combined rule must additionally beat CMF-only and room-only on net without worse DD or monthly regression beyond250. Never relax due to losing baseline. Show descriptive leaders even if no qualifier; no untouched holdout claim.
verification: Before new economics reproduce all selected archived LV02 baseline cases exactly: stats/trades/accepted/monthly/open/curve after JSON normalization, using journal byte offsets. Seal consumed artifacts and transitive math/engine dependencies; protected live files hash-only pre/post. Save contexts once; reuse for exits and variants. Main agent checks raw profile as-of projection and indicator source clocks; existing independent long auditCap and short auditShort check every unique journal. Synthetic null/equality/direction/origin-exclusion and prefix/future-poison checks. Do not amend earlier accepted files. Pending output cannot be called accepted before verification.
limits: All earlier work is development history. Preserve Sep15 cutoff to isolate strategy, not a new sync extension. Fees before funding; no margin/liquidation, live queue or maker fill claim. Daily NPOC sample can be sparse and correlated. Loss reduction can merely discard winners; report baseline-adjacent W/L dollars and full monthlies for top five. No live config, short reactivation, commits or deployment.
